item.title: Pantograph 1.1.5
item.description:
New

  • Choose which way scrolling zooms. Settings › Viewing has separate Scroll-wheel zoom and Trackpad zoom choices, each Standard or Reversed. Pantograph already follows macOS's Natural Scrolling setting, but mouse apps such as Logi Options+ can reverse a mouse's wheel without macOS knowing, which made zooming go the wrong way. The first time you zoom with a scroll wheel, Pantograph tells you where the setting is.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself. Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.5.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
